facts.title: Learn Skinning
facts.note: No level requirement in Forever. Riley teaches only Apprentice, to skill 75.

facts.title: Journeyman Skinning at skill 50
facts.note: No level requirement for any Skinning rank: Journeyman at 50, Expert at 125, Artisan at 200. Helene teaches every rank; so do Maris Granger (Old Town, Stormwind) and Wilma Ranthal (Redridge Mountains).

facts.title: Camp Chair (Skinning 20)
facts.location: Skinning trainer, or the Camping 101 quest
facts.note: 3 Light Leather and 2 Simple Wood. +2% crit chance; does not stack with Moonkin Aura.
